description: Test scenarios for detecting thread pinning in proxy connections with Java 21 Virtual Threads

scenarios.name: Basic Proxy Connection
scenarios.description: Tests a simple HTTP request through a proxy without authentication
potentialPinningPoints: When closing the connection due to synchronized blocks in AbstractInterruptibleChannel.close()
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Connection should be established, request sent, and response received without thread pinning

scenarios.name: Basic Authentication Proxy
scenarios.description: Tests HTTP request through a proxy requiring basic authentication
potentialPinningPoints: When processing 407 Proxy Authentication Required response
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Authentication should succeed and request should complete without thread pinning

scenarios.name: Digest Authentication Proxy
scenarios.description: Tests HTTP request through a proxy requiring digest authentication
potentialPinningPoints: During digest computation which may use synchronized methods
When handling multiple round-trips for authentication
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Digest authentication should complete and request should succeed without thread pinning

scenarios.name: SSL/TLS Proxy Connection
scenarios.description: Tests HTTPS request through a proxy with SSL/TLS handshake
potentialPinningPoints: During SSL/TLS handshake which uses native methods
scenarios.expectedBehavior: SSL handshake should complete and secure request should succeed with minimal thread pinning

scenarios.name: Connection Pooling with Proxy
scenarios.description: Tests connection pooling behavior with proxy connections
potentialPinningPoints: When acquiring connection from pool (may use synchronized methods)
When managing connection lifecycle in pool
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Connection should be reused from pool without thread pinning

scenarios.name: Timeout and Retry with Proxy
scenarios.description: Tests timeout handling and retry logic with proxy connections
potentialPinningPoints: During timeout handling which may use synchronized timers
During retry logic which may use locks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Timeout should be detected and retry should succeed without thread pinning

scenarios.name: Large Payload Through Proxy
scenarios.description: Tests handling of large request and response payloads through proxy
potentialPinningPoints: During large data transfer which may use synchronized buffers
When closing the connection after large transfer
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Large payload should be transferred without thread pinning

scenarios.name: Multiple Concurrent Requests Through Proxy
scenarios.description: Tests multiple concurrent requests through the same proxy
potentialPinningPoints: When managing multiple connections through same proxy
When handling proxy routing for multiple requests
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All concurrent requests should complete without thread pinning

scenarios.name: Proxy with HTTP Redirect
scenarios.description: Tests handling of HTTP redirects through proxy
potentialPinningPoints: During redirect handling logic which may use locks
When establishing new connections for redirects
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Redirects should be followed without thread pinning

scenarios.name: SOCKS Proxy Connection
scenarios.description: Tests HTTP request through a SOCKS proxy
potentialPinningPoints: During SOCKS protocol handshake which may use native methods
When authenticating with the SOCKS proxy
During address resolution in SOCKS implementation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: SOCKS proxy connection should complete without thread pinning

scenarios.name: Proxy Connection Interruption
scenarios.description: Tests behavior when proxy connection is interrupted
potentialPinningPoints: During exception handling which may use synchronized blocks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Connection interruption should be handled gracefully without thread pinning
